review: 701.18a-1: the opponents_turn variant changed both the active player and the step; it now changes only the active player (main1 of B's turn, A holding priority).
701.18a: the sentence that putting a land onto the battlefield with an effect is not playing a land had no scenario; added 701.18a-2 (Rampant Growth then a land play).

scenarios.title: A land can be played only with priority, in the player's own main phase, with an empty stack and a land drop left

setup.notes: A has priority with an empty stack (except in stack_not_empty). A has not played a land this turn.

decisions: A considers playing Forest from hand.

variants.label: legal
variants.expected: Playing Forest is legal. Forest enters the battlefield directly without using the stack, and the stack stays empty.

variants.label: land_already_played
variants.delta: A has already played a land this turn.
variants.expected: Playing Forest is not legal. Forest stays in hand.

variants.label: combat_step
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Playing Forest is not legal. Forest stays in hand.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: B's Shock targeting A is on the stack in A's main phase (B's Mountain is tapped for it), and A has priority.
variants.expected: Playing Forest is not legal. Forest stays in hand.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player (the step is still main1); B has passed priority with an empty stack and A has priority.
variants.expected: Playing Forest is not legal on B's turn. Forest stays in hand.

scenarios.title: Putting a land onto the battlefield with a spell is not playing a land

setup.notes: A has not played a land this turn.

decisions: A casts Rampant Growth, tapping both Forests; both players pass and it resolves: A searches for the Forest in A's library and puts it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffles.
With an empty stack in main1, A considers playing a Forest from hand.

variants.label: land_put_by_spell
variants.expected: Playing the Forest from hand is legal: the Forest Rampant Growth put onto the battlefield was not a land play.

variants.label: land_played
variants.delta: Instead of casting Rampant Growth, A plays a Forest from hand first.
variants.expected: Playing the second Forest from hand is not legal; it stays in hand.
